Subject: OrionTech security review + demo — aligning procurement and timeline

Hi Emily / John —

Thanks for taking the time to evaluate Redwood. We want to align two things in one call: a short technical demo for your engineering team (20–30m) and a security/compliance review with your security and procurement stakeholders (30–40m). To keep this efficient, our proposal is a 60–75 minute session with distinct blocks: 25m demo (Dev), 30m security deep-dive (Security), then 10–15m procurement/next steps.

Proposed windows (PT):
- Tue, Mar 28 — 10:00–11:15 AM PT
- Wed, Mar 29 — 2:00–3:15 PM PT

Please confirm which of the two windows works or share 3 slots that fit your schedule. Who from your side should join from security and procurement? I’ve CC’d our SE (Dev) and our security lead (Soojin) so they can prep the evidence pack.

Attachments: Initial-Security-Questionnaire.pdf (short form), Demo-Agenda-v1.docx

If easier, here is a scheduling link: https://cal.com/avery-redwood/intro-demo

Thanks — looking forward to getting this on the calendar.

Best,

Hi Avery —

Thanks — we’d like to participate in the combined session. Procurement is looped in (procurement@oriontech.com). Our security lead (me) and John (engineering) will attend.

We can do Wed, Mar 29 — 2:00–3:15 PM PT (the second slot). A couple of asks before the call so we can come prepared:
- Can you share SOC 2 attestation (or link to your audit report) and any third-party penetration test summaries?
- A simple data-flow diagram showing what data (if any) is sent to Redwood and what is retained for logs/metrics.

Also, procurement wanted a rough timeline for contracting (MSA + SOW). Roughly, we need pricing + a draft MSA to start a procurement review.
